correctness.rationale: Averaging over signed-coordinate permutations reduces arbitrary linear operators (including signed coefficients) to three stabilizer orbits; KR duality and incident-vertex/disjoint-edge tests yield affine universal lower bounds. For the explicit positive rows, all incident, antipodal, outside and same/shared/disjoint midpoint pair types have costs <= the proposed optimum. Dimension three has no disjoint midpoint pair and is optimized by two alternate affine bounds. Independently solved 153,496,1225 exact-point-pair KR dual linear programs for d=3,4,5, with maxima 1.115603109315,1.155903758158,1.159197416691, matching the formula; the unrestricted d argument uses the symmetry proof, not finite LPs.
residual_risks: Finite-dimensional LP checks cover d=3,4,5 only; all-dimensional certification rests on the transport case analysis.
